headline: 6 deaths in 24 hours: Dengue cases surge in Bangladesh
summary: Over 1,600 people were hospitalized in a single day, as total deaths this year reach 256 according to the Directorate General of Health Services.
details: Six people died from dengue in the last 24 hours, while 1,608 patients were admitted to hospitals across the country, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
This sudden spike in hospitalizations highlights the ongoing severity of the outbreak, with total deaths this year reaching 256.
The Dhaka South City Corporation area has been the hardest hit, recording the highest number of fatalities with 72 deaths.
September alone saw a significant surge in mortality, with 148 people losing their lives nationwide.
To date, 84,369 dengue patients have been hospitalized this year, with 78,482 patients having recovered and returned home.
caption:
6 deaths and 1,608 hospitalizations in just 24 hours. The dengue crisis is intensifying.

To date, 84,369 dengue patients have been hospitalized this year, with 78,482 patients having recovered and returned home.

headline_marked: Jamaat leader [[Akhtaruzzaman placed on 1-day remand]] after airport chaos
headline: Jamaat leader Akhtaruzzaman placed on 1-day remand after airport chaos
summary: Major (Retd) Akhtaruzzaman faces criticism for allegedly throwing a helmet and making adverse comments about a judge during court proceedings.
details: Jamaat-e-Islami leader Major (Retd) Akhtaruzzaman has been placed on a one-day remand following chaos at the airport.
The leader is facing significant criticism for his behavior during the legal process, including allegedly throwing a helmet while exiting a prison van.
Reports indicate that Akhtaruzzaman made adverse comments regarding a judge in court, further complicating his legal situation.
He was also involved in chanting slogans during the proceedings, contributing to the overall disorder.
The remand is intended to facilitate further investigation into the incidents that occurred at the airport and his conduct in court.
caption:
Throwing a helmet and insulting a judge? Jamaat leader Akhtaruzzaman is now on remand.

Jamaat-e-Islami leader Major (Retd) Akhtaruzzaman has been placed on a one-day remand following chaos at the airport.

The leader is facing significant criticism for his behavior during the legal process, including allegedly throwing a helmet while exiting a prison van.

Reports indicate that Akhtaruzzaman made adverse comments regarding a judge in court, further complicating his legal situation.

He was also involved in chanting slogans during the proceedings, contributing to the overall disorder.

The remand is intended to facilitate further investigation into the incidents that occurred at the airport and his conduct in court.

#Bangladesh #Politics #Jamaat #LegalNews #Dhaka

Source: Prothom Alo, Jamuna TV
